polaris_adaptations.detail: The Polaris runner owns collection, analysis, report, resume, status, and review continuation; no source-application orchestrator is called.
The shared Polaris tool loader translates canonical POLARIS_LITERATURE_* settings, removes WANGHAI_* settings before execution, and is reused by the workflow adapter.
Each LiteratureReviewExecution node is bound in workflow.json to one root-level entry in tools/tool-inventory.json; the workflow is not registered as a common tool.
POLARIS_LITERATURE_CODEX_BIN selects the underlying binary while the fixed Polaris workflow wrapper remains the default CODEX_CLI.
Collection and analysis handoffs are validated again at the Polaris boundary and bound to the requested collection, analysis, and report identifiers.

The collection manual-review state machine, stable review identities, audit trail, atomic export, and v2 continuation are owned by the Polaris workflow; the producer metadata is Polaris-owned while the clue review-output contract remains compatible.
Direct execution and review continuation fail closed when POLARIS_LITERATURE_RUNTIME_MODE=polaris; the durable Polaris job remains the integration point.
